H3_Combat_V2 runs without its intensity trigger on purpose: the author's guidance is that no trigger gives the most stable anatomy, and prfight2 is only for more aggression. Write unarmed exchanges as single, clearly separated strikes: one attacker acts per beat, each strike has a visible start and a visible end, and the two bodies stay far enough apart that every limb reads clearly.
